display_name: PTI comprehensive health care insurance through Gras Savoye (Decision 268/QĐ-PTI-BHCN, 26 September 2012): definitions, the seven benefits, general conditions, general exclusions, the table of injury rates, extension clauses, claims procedure and the emergency transport annex

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comment lines generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the text rendering, and in short runs (in the modules, GLOSSARY.md, COMPARABLES.md, NOTES.md) checked by tools/vnsrc.py check to occur verbatim in it. No Vietnamese is the encoder's own.

source.authority: aid: a mirror on a university website (hcmiu.edu.vn), not the publisher's own site; issuer PTI (Tổng Công ty Cổ phần Bảo hiểm Bưu điện)

scope: The whole document: Part I (69 definitions; those no clause uses are inert), Part II (Benefits 1-7), Part III (general conditions 1-14), Part IV (32 general exclusions and the second 32 with its table), Part V (the table of injury rates, 126 printed rows generated from the text, and its six principles), Part VI (extension clauses 1-12), Part VII (claims procedure; the blank claim form and the signature are inert) and the Annex on emergency medical transport (Benefit 7). Everything the contract or schedule states (sums insured, limits, benefits and extensions chosen, dates, premium, rate of exchange) is an input. Declined by name where the document does not answer: the territory a contract extends to, waiting periods a contract varies, Part II heads with no grant (newborn care, taxi, ambulance, home nursing money), VI.12's paying benefit, III.7 terms of 5, 7 and 8 months, III.12's open 'v.v…', III.13 for Benefits 1, 3, 5, 7, principle 6 for unlisted injuries, the share refused for late accident documents or a late Annex notice. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: Defs 36/38: the start date is the date of first joining while cover has been continuous.
forks.F2: Def 40: 'up to 70', 'up to 18', '24' include the named age.
forks.F4: Ages in completed years and months.
forks.F5: III.1: 'bắt đầu tuổi 66' is having reached 66.
forks.F6: Def 35: 'và' read as union of >24h inpatient and day treatment.
forks.F7: Defs 49/56: a listed total-injury row is total permanent injury without 52 weeks.
forks.F8: Def 58: the last 3 years before the start date.
forks.F9: III.8: only def-58 pre-existing conditions are risks before cover.
forks.F10: Periods 'tính từ' a day count that day as day 1.
forks.F11: IV second 32 table replaces III.8's 365 days for Benefits 4 and 6 in groups of 30+.
forks.F12: IV second 32: a group under 30 has a 12-month first-year exclusion.
forks.F14: Ambiguous exclusions read narrowly (LAW art 24, aid line 588-591).
forks.F15: IV.28: 'training or competing' governs professional sport, dangerous sport and racing.
forks.F16: IV.2: a traffic offence under 14 is not excluded.
forks.F18: III.8 proviso: days insured count the start date as day 1.
forks.F19: III.13: 'quyền lợi 3 (Chi phí y tế do tai nạn)' is Benefit 2.
forks.F20: III.11: the larger of excess and proportion (LAW art 24).
forks.F21: III.6: 'toàn phần' is TPD; two years from the injury.
forks.F22: V principle 6 declined for unlisted injuries.
forks.F23: V principle 5: limb cap is the highest rate of items 8/27.
forks.F24: VI.1: monthly notice is a condition of automatic cover.
forks.F26: VI.2: liability arising before termination survives non-payment.
forks.F28: VI.3: 20% cap on all traditional medicine; none without VI.3.
forks.F30: VI.6: suffocation counts as accident without a visible force.
forks.F31: VI.8 does not deem an accident.
forks.F33: IV second 32: the '>50' row governs a group over 50.
forks.F35: Waiting periods tested at the date of the loss.
forks.F36: III.12: climbing and surfing caught in their own right.
forks.F37: VI.12 checks answered under Benefit 6; amount declined.
forks.F38: Benefit 5: accident insurance is Benefit 1 or 2.
forks.F39: Pre- and post-hospital costs paid with the stay's benefit.
forks.F40: Benefit 2's list closed outside a hospital stay.
forks.F42: Consumables count as surgery costs under Benefit 4.
forks.F44: No-treatment claims count from the date of the loss.
forks.F45: The 12-month document limit binds accident claims only.
forks.F46: Payment by the 15th working day, Monday-Friday, holidays an input.
forks.F47: Annex 90 days: days away at the event.
forks.F48: Annex II.4: 'place of the accident' read as place of the event for illness.
forks.F49: Part VII time limits do not bind direct-billing claims.
forks.F50: Leave and death papers asked for whatever the accident.
forks.F51: Annex II.3: the main policy is Benefit 4 or 2.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run (the row was briefed as one session with no sub-agents). Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the source before it was asserted; the per-row table tests were generated from the text by a second, independent reading of each printed line.
